entities.name: Elías Lafertte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Elías Lafertte Gaviño was a Chilean worker in saltpeter mining and a communist politician. Lafertte ran in the 1931 and 1932 presidential elections ending in third and fifth place. He was senator from 1937 to 1953.

entities.name: Elías Lafertte

entities.summary: Elías Lafertte Gaviño was a Chilean worker in saltpeter mining and a communist politician. Lafertte ran in the 1931 and 1932 presidential elections ending in third and fifth place. He was senator from 1937 to 1953.
